mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, provider, provider_user_id, nickname, role) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{nickname}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oauth_accounts (user_id, provider, provider_user_id) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE linked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT IGNORE INTO user_profiles (user_id, cash, monthly_savings, target_amount, age, income) VALUES (#{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 30, 500)

INSERT IGNORE INTO user_sim_configs (user_id, savings_increase_rate, investment_return_rate, apartment_annual_rise, ltv_ratio, acquisition_tax_rate) VALUES (#{userId}, 5.00, 8.00, 3.00, 0.500, 0.0350)
